name: Gorilla Heights
summary: Gorilla Heights takes your favorite gorilla movement to new heights! Explore unique, vertically-focused maps. Swing, climb, and challenge your friends to reach the highest points. Discover hidden pathways and master thrilling new climbing techniques. Experience a fresh take on gorilla gameplay in this exciting fan-made adventure. Test your skills against intricate level designs that demand precision and agility. Compete for the fastest times in time trial challenges. Unlock cosmetic items to personalize you
